app.name: Inventory Platform
app.tagline: Stock, orders and billing for distributors and their retailers

auth.platformSignInBody: For the platform team. Two-step verification is required.
auth.staffSignInBody: Use the email address your business invited.
auth.shopOwnerLink: Shop owner? Sign in with your mobile number
auth.chooseTenant: You work for more than one business. Choose one to continue.
auth.unavailableBody: This account is currently unavailable. Please contact your distributor.
auth.wrongAreaTitle: This page is not for your account
auth.wrongAreaBody: You are signed in with an account that uses a different part of the app.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.codePrompt: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.recoveryPrompt: Enter one of the recovery codes you saved when you set up two-step verification.

enrol.title: Set up two-step verification
enrol.intro: Your account needs two-step verification. You will need an authenticator app on your phone, such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator.
enrol.stepScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enrol.stepCode: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
enrol.qrLabel: QR code to add this account to your authenticator app
enrol.manual: Can't scan? Enter this key instead

recovery.title: Save your recovery codes
recovery.intro: If you lose your phone, each of these codes lets you sign in once. Keep them somewhere safe; they are shown only now.
recovery.confirm: I have saved these codes somewhere safe

strength.hint: Use at least 10 characters. A few words together work well.

retailer.title: Sign in to order
retailer.body: We'll send a 6-digit code to your mobile number.
retailer.phoneHint: The number your distributor has for your shop.
retailer.chooseDistributor: Your number is registered with more than one distributor. Choose where to shop.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.body: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses this email address, we've sent a link to reset the password. Check your inbox.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed and you've been signed out everywhere. Sign in with the new password.

invite.title: Join {business}
invite.existingAccount: You already have an account with this email. Enter its password to join.

home.platformEmptyBody: Distributor management arrives in the next release.
home.distributorEmptyBody: Orders, stock and billing will appear here as features are released.
home.shopEmptyBody: Products from your distributor will appear here soon.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Check your internet connection. Your cart is safe — try again when you are back online.

table.emptyBody: When records are added they will show up here.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.PARSE_ERROR: We could not read that request. Please try again.
errors.AUTHENTICATION_FAILED: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: That file or data type isn't supported.
errors.THROTTLED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.CONFLICT: This was changed by someone else. Please refresh and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong on our side. Please try again.
errors.TENANT_CONTEXT_MISSING: Your workspace could not be identified. Please sign in again.
errors.CROSS_TENANT_ACCESS: This record belongs to a different workspace.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different details. Please start again.
errors.INVALID_STATE_TRANSITION: This can't be done at the current stage.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The email or password is incorrect. After several failed attempts, sign-in is paused for a few minutes.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.TENANT_UNAVAILABLE: This account is currently unavailable. Please contact your distributor.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: This link or code has expired or was already used. Please start again.
errors.SESSION_EXPIRED: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.MFA_INVALID_CODE: That code didn't work. Check your authenticator app and try again.
errors.MFA_REQUIRED_BY_POLICY: Two-step verification is required for your account and can't be turned off.
errors.OTP_INVALID: That code is wrong or has expired. Please ask for a new code.
errors.PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED: Your plan's limit has been reached. Please contact the platform team to upgrade.
errors.LAST_OWNER: Every business needs at least one active owner. Make someone else an owner first.
errors.ALREADY_A_MEMBER: This person is already on your team.
errors.SLUG_CHANGE_NOT_CONFIRMED: Changing the web address breaks saved links, installed apps and current sign-ins. Confirm the change to continue.
errors.IMPERSONATION_READ_ONLY: This support session is view-only. Switch to act mode (with a reason) to make changes.
errors.IMPERSONATION_BLOCKED: This can't be done in a support session, even in act mode.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: You seem to be offline. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.

designSystem.title: Design system
designSystem.description: Tokens and shared components used across the platform, in every state.
designSystem.brandHint: Tenants set one colour; the full scale is derived automatically.
designSystem.sampleBody: Body text is set in one family with a clear hierarchy.

impersonation.actingAs: Support session: acting as {name} (every change is recorded)
impersonation.minutesLeft: {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} left
impersonation.actBody: Changes are recorded in the business's audit log with your name. Passwords, two-step verification, staff and bank details can't be changed in a support session.
